scope: File manager: Companion tags, zip and unzip, new sort keys, and Properties.

topics.title: Companion tags
details: Press Space to tag or untag a file or folder. You hear how many items are tagged.
Tags stay when you open another folder. Tag items in several folders, then copy or delete them all at once.
Control+Shift+T says what is tagged. Control+Shift+A clears the tags.

topics.title: Zip and unzip
details: Alt+Z zips the tagged items, or the current one. Companion suggests a name. Press Enter to use it.
Alt+U unzips a zip file into a new folder with the same name. Nothing already there is changed.

topics.title: Properties
details: Alt+Enter shows the properties of a file or folder. Use Up Arrow and Down Arrow to hear each one.
Music files also give the title, artist, album, genre, year, track, and length.

topics.title: New sort keys
details: Control+1 sorts by name. Control+2 sorts by date modified. Control+3 sorts by type.
Control+4 sorts by size. Control+5 sorts by date created.
Press the same key again to switch between ascending and descending.

topics.title: A simpler File manager screen
details: Tab no longer moves to buttons. Search and Sort are on the Alt menu now.
The Alt menu has four groups: Actions, Search, Sort, and Go to.
